measures.technique: Integration test of the provider data plane with its neighbours replaced by a recording HTTP double for the customer's backend and for the registry: assets are created with each combination of the data address flags (proxyMethod, proxyPath, proxyQueryParams, proxyBody) and two agreements are concluded; a consumer pulls under each, sending GET, POST and PUT requests with paths, query strings, bodies and content types, and with caller-set Edc-Bpn, X-Forwarded-For and Forwarded headers, while the double answers with status codes 200, 202, 400, 404, 422 and 500 and records every request it receives.
